steps.content: Focus the attacks. Keep pushing. With forces converging from inside and out, the barrier is torn open. You see scores of Sinners escaping, and command your squad to get them to safety.

steps.speaker: DisCorps Soldier
steps.content: We've tracked down the signal. They're mostly imprisoned Sinners and staff on the ship.

steps.speaker: DisCorps Soldier
steps.content: We've brought them under protection. Awaiting further orders.
The doctor supports you, clearly intending to get you back to the cabin. Releasing the shackles helped you find the right direction, but it also exacerbated the corruption. Your head is ringing.
But a sharper unease hammers at you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You stay here and help with the rescue. I need a few people to go in with me. I...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: We can't stop here. There's more to this...

You force your weakened body to stand, watching as Euphoria is being consumed by Mania in the distance. You realize it's some kind of self-destruct protocol. Somewhere you can't see, the enemy is making their final move.
You have to go there. Now. You can't say why. To salvage intel? To hunt down the mastermind? No, it's more than that...
Your temples throb. In the rising contamination, your intuition tells you that something else is there. An immense power. An S-class Sinner? An Apostle? Underground sorcery? Or maybe...
Beep...
A message comes through the comms. Same source as before, but much closer this time.
The comms officer quickly decrypts the code and patches the message to you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This is...!
To the MBCC Chief, or whoever gets this:
HURRY! PLEASE! SAVE HER!! Only you can save her. Please, I'm begging you!
Sallie frantically mashes the keys, repeating the same words over and over as tears splatter onto her hands and the console.

Cassian's boat struggles against the quicksand, straining under the weight of three people. There's no telling how long it'll take to break through the barrier and reach rescue teams. She can only hope this signal can get through the sandstorm and reach someone—anyone—a little sooner.

steps.speaker: Sallie
steps.content: Sob... Sob... please... just a little faster, please...

Step by step, Milly walks down the wrecked corridor, through the sunless cage that has been her home for years. The power inside her surges through the space, draining her even as it guides her to her destination.
Corruptor contamination blocks her path, and she's taken a few hits. But she's happy that everyone else has left. Milly's in such a good mood, she starts to hum a tune.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Is our Sallie crying right now? We had so little time, I couldn't explain anything properly. Maybe we'll get another chance someday.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I know I told you I wouldn't listen, but you really did teach me so much. You've gone to school, seen the world... You're smarter and more level-headed than I am. And you even got to be with the one you love. I envy you.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: You showed me that love isn't always sweet, that there won't always be perfect understanding. That the ones we love aren't necessarily strong and perfect; maybe we don't really understand each other. Maybe someday, we'll drift apart.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I learned how terrifying it is to give your heart to someone. Love makes you vulnerable. I suppose I've never truly experienced love, since I've never worried about that.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: But what it gave me was more than enough.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Just thinking of that person, remembering a single moment, brings me joy and makes my heart race. My whole world changed. Whether in Syndicate or here, the night no longer strangled me with its grip. I had sweet dreams instead of nightmares.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I could imagine happiness again. I could look forward to tomorrow. I became so much braver. Things I never thought I could do, I now have the courage to try. I can feel kindness again, and I want to embrace the world, to love everyone around me, even if they push me away.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: If this is the power of hormones and dopamine that scared you so much, then I want to thank it. It's incredible! An illogical, devastating force. It must be life's gift to all of us.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: You must have felt it too, right? You didn't hesitate to shoot that terrifying raincoat monster. Even your timid Theodore found the courage to charge out and fight me.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Love can turn us into fools, but it can also make us blessed heroes. I've seen how strong you are, Sallie. This awful world shouldn't scare you at all. Even if Theodore really is a scumbag, there's nothing to be afraid of.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I hope we can all be free to love whoever we want to love.

The long road comes to an end. She's back on the stage. It no longer shines with its usual splendor. The magnificent curtains are torn apart, the tiles shattered to pieces. Electric sparks dance among the ruins.
Someone is waiting for her.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: ...You still haven't learned your lesson, Milly. Didn't that Chief tell you, back in Syndicate?

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: "Stay where you are, and protect yourself. He will come back for you." If only you'd listened and waited there like a good girl. Why did you have to run out after him?
steps.female_content: "Stay where you are, and protect yourself. She will come back for you." If only you'd listened and waited there like a good girl. Why did you have to run out after her?

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: If you hadn't run out, the bad guys would never have caught you and sold you to me. Your love story could've had a happy ending.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Hehe, who knew he was so amazing? It was chaos out there, and I was worried. It was the first time I'd ever loved someone. I didn't know what was the right thing to do.
steps.female_content: Hehe, who knew she was so amazing? It was chaos out there, and I was worried. It was the first time I'd ever loved someone. I didn't know what was the right thing to do.

steps.content: She walks onto the stage, smoothing her dress like she always does. It's a gown her boss had custom-made for her, exquisitely adorned. Before every show, she would gratefully adjust it to perfection.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: You were very kind to me, Mr. E. No one in Syndicate was ever that good to me. I loved those beautiful stories you told me. "True love conquers all." So romantic. But, sir, what you said and what you did were two different things. All you wanted was to crush love under your feet.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: The chaotic voice rises from the void, slowly engulfing the entire street.
Mr. E watches her with his usual loving, gentle smile. Black ichor flows from his hands, coalescing into an umbrella, which he opens gracefully.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: True. But you can no longer do that.

steps.speaker: Mr. E
steps.content: You made a pact with the Sage. Your power comes from the Underground, and you must surrender everything to death.
As if summoned by the black umbrella, Mania writhes toward them from all directions, slithering onto the stage.

Half of it converges at their feet, forming a sinister rune circle from which massive, dark figures begin to take shape. The other half crawls up Milly's body, tearing and pulling, trying to rip her to shreds with her golden gown.
Milly watches with an unflinching gaze. After a long moment, she smiles.

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: You're wrong. Love gave me this power, and I'll give everything I have for love.
She walks to the center of the stage and casts away the extravagant gown, the costume that adorned her, betrayed her, and shackled her.
She'll never need it again.

Such relief. Such liberation. The monsters, the vines entangling her, the power that burns so brilliantly only to fade... none of it is to be feared.
This is Euphoria's final performance. The band in her head begins to play; her dancers have gone ahead to the new world, and as for the audience...
She'll just pretend her beloved ${PlayerName} is sitting in the front row.

I'm sorry, my dear ${PlayerName}. I took the liberty of imagining you as the hero who would come and take me away. Even minutes ago, when I sensed people arriving, I still dreamed you were among them.
On second thought, that's still me waiting for you to save me. A bit pathetic, isn't it?
[Scene Change] Chief's Side
Through the rift, a boat is heading toward the heart of the vortex, against the tide of people fleeing.

steps.speaker: Doctor
steps.content: Slow down! The contamination there is no joke. I'm not about to let you die.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The Mania is retreating, pulled inward... Is something gathering power? But it's not steadily rising.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The contamination levels at the center are fluctuating violently, with sharp, frequent dips... Someone's weakening it. Someone's still down there, fighting the Mania.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...We need to hurry. We must get there fast.
It's been a long, long time since that day. So long, I almost forgot what you looked like. Sallie had to tell me before I realized... I want to know the real you.

Behind all those legendary stories and great titles, what kind of person is the real ${PlayerName}? What do you like? What do you dislike? Do you ever feel afraid or lonely? What are the things you're good at? What about the ones you struggle with?
I want to meet your friends, too, and learn about your work. Oh! I wonder if you already have someone special?
Would it be a burden to be loved by someone you've only met once...? Then maybe I'll just hide my feelings so you don't find out. Don't worry, I'm a great actress!
But it would be better if I could candidly tell you how I feel.

From the audience, inside a hidden boat, Evelleon watches the man holding the umbrella beside her.
Mr. E's face twists, contorts, and ruptures, as if under attack by an invisible assailant, before finally melting into a puddle of sludge.
The color has returned to Evelleon's arm. The ritual is over. A spot of good luck, but a shame all the same.
She waves a hand. The boat turns and sails into the void.
It's amazing how those unseen futures make my heart race. I long for the stories we might share, yearn for you to enter my world. Meeting you has given me so many feelings.
[CG - Redemption 1]
[CG - Redemption 2]
You give me joy and sorrow. You move me, change me, set me ablaze. We'll go on an adventure unlike any other. Even if it's fleeting, I can't wait.
This is the passion you give me, the feeling I call love. If it is wrong and false...
...then show me what's right! Show me who you truly are!
That's what I wish for so fervently... to see you again.
[CRASH!]
A massive steel beam smashes through the ceiling from above. The fatal blow from the lion-faced figure misses Milly's head. She staggers, looking up in a daze.
A gaping hole is torn in the sealed roof. Light and sand pour in, blinding her. It hurts so much, and she's so tired, but...
Is this a dream? She thinks she hears someone calling her. Milly turns her head...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: Ah...

steps.speaker: Milly
steps.content: I knew it...
Miracles do happen.
After all, even in a world like this... one can still find love...
